description: Always-available filesystem tools plus shell, web_search, web_extract, scheme_repl, and task tools.

edit_file.description: Replace an exact stretch of text in an existing file. Requires the user's confirmation.

path.description: File path, relative to the project root.

description.description: Optional one-line summary of what this edit does.

fff_search.description: Fuzzy file search under the project root (typo-resistant, frecency-ranked).

cwd.description: Directory to search, relative to the project root. Defaults to the project root.

fff_search.question: search **{{query}}**{{#cwd}} in **{{cwd}}**{{/cwd}}?

glob.description: Find files under the project root whose paths match a glob pattern.

cwd.description: Directory to search, relative to the project root. Defaults to the project root.

glob.question: glob `{{pattern}}`{{#cwd}} in **{{cwd}}**{{/cwd}}?

grep.description: Search file contents under the project root (indexed). mode is plain (literal, default), regex, or fuzzy.

pattern.description: Text, regex, or fuzzy query depending on mode.

path.description: Directory or file to search. Defaults to the project root.

glob.description: Only search paths matching this glob.

grep.question:
grep **{{pattern}}**{{#path}} in **{{path}}**{{/path}}?{{#glob}}
glob `{{glob}}`{{/glob}}

list_dir.description: List the entries of a directory under the project root. Directories end with '/'.

path.description: Directory path, relative to the project root. Use '.' for the root.

depth.description: How many levels to descend. Defaults to 1.

list_dir.question:
list **{{path}}**?{{#depth}}
depth `{{depth}}`{{/depth}}

read_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file under the project root.

path.description: File path, relative to the project root.

limit.description: How many lines to return from offset.

read_file.question: Read **{{path}}**?

scheme_repl.description: Evaluate a Scheme expression. Inner tool calls use the normal tool execution and approval flow.

period.description: Repeat interval: "N minutes", "N hours", or "N days". Omit to run once. expr must call (meta-reactivity/done-condition pred [result]) on a reachable path. Each iteration has no inner-call or time limit unless maxInternalCalls or timeoutMs is set; idle time between iterations does not count.

background.description: If true, return without waiting for the program to finish; deliver its result later as a notification.

timeoutMs.description: Optional per-tick timeout in milliseconds. Omit for no time limit.

maxInternalCalls.description: Optional inner tool-call budget. Omit for no limit.

description.description: Optional one-line summary of what this expression does.

scheme_repl.question: eval `{{expr}}`?

text.description: Door text when the call failed.

value.description: Scheme results from the last evaluation.

shell.description: Run a command in the project workspace through /bin/sh. Requires confirmation, separately from file writes.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the project root.

description.description: Optional one-line summary of what this command does.

shell.question:
run `{{command}}`?{{#cwd}}
in **{{cwd}}**{{/cwd}}

text.description: Door text when the call failed.

write_file.description: Create a file under the project root, or replace one entirely. Replacing an existing file requires overwriteExisting. Requires the user's confirmation.

path.description: File path, relative to the project root.

overwriteExisting.description: Set true to replace an existing file.

description.description: Optional one-line summary of what this write does.

write_file.question:
{{#existed}}update{{/existed}}{{^existed}}create{{/existed}} **{{path}}**?{{#content}}
**{{content}}**{{/content}}

web_search.description: Search the public web. Returns ranked titles, URLs, and snippets.

numResults.description: How many hits to return. Defaults to 5.

web_search.question: search **{{query}}**?

text.description: Door text when the call failed.

web_extract.description: Fetch a public URL and return readable markdown. Use after web_search when you have a URL.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to read.

charLimit.description: Maximum markdown characters to return. Defaults to 15000.

web_extract.question: extract **{{url}}**?

task__create.description: Create a task with pending status and return its taskId. The harness manages status; completion requires task__validate, not a completed argument. The validationProgram is saved at creation and cannot be replaced. It must inspect current project state through files, tests, or a :readonly agent/ask using the task requirements, then call (tasks/write-completion-verdict ok comments). Returning #t or (list #t "…") is not a stamp. ;; use one-shot for schema-constrained responses

activeForm.description: Progress label displayed while this task is active.

activationBrief.description: Instructions to follow when this task becomes active.

validationProgram.description: Scheme validation program saved at creation and run later by task__validate; it cannot be replaced. Inspect current project state through files, tests, or a :readonly agent/ask using the task requirements, then call (tasks/write-completion-verdict ok comments). Returning #t or (list #t "…") is not a stamp. ;; use one-shot for schema-constrained responses

task__start.description: Start a task and return its subject and activationBrief. Only one task can be active; any previously active task returns to pending. Starting an already-active task changes nothing.
task__start.question: start `{{taskId}}`?

text.description: Door text when the call failed.

task__drop.description: Drop a task and save the reason. Completed tasks cannot be dropped. Dropping an already-dropped task changes nothing. Returns no value.

reason.description: Reason for dropping this task. Saved with the task.

task__drop.question:
drop `{{taskId}}`?{{#reason}}
{{reason}}{{/reason}}

text.description: Door text when the call failed.

task__after.description: Add a prerequisite: taskId waits until after is completed. Does not start either task. Returns no value.

taskId.description: Task ID returned by task__create. This task waits for the prerequisite.

after.description: Prerequisite task ID. The dependent task waits until this task is completed.

task__after.question: after `{{taskId}}` `{{after}}`?

text.description: Door text when the call failed.

task__validate.description: Validate the active task using the validationProgram saved at creation; no replacement program is accepted. That program must call (tasks/write-completion-verdict ok comments) after checking current project state. The tool returns that pair, or delivers it later as a notification when background is true.

taskId.description: Task ID returned by task__create. This task must be active.

background.description: If true, return without waiting and deliver the (boolean, string) validation result later as a notification. Defaults to false: wait and return the result directly.

task__validate.question: {{#background}}background-{{/background}}validate `{{taskId}}`?

text.description: Door text when the call failed.
